posts.text: Good piece from @coachbrucepearl on how March Madness brings Americans together. thefp.com/p/bruce-pearl-how-…
Today Alabama’s AD said the era of conference title games was over. Would you rather start the college football playoff sooner or keep the SEC, Big Ten, ACC and Big 12 title games?

Vandy is the most selective in the SEC, but in my home state of Tennessee getting into UT has become difficult, even for kids with great test scores & GPAs. When I graduated high school you needed a pulse to get in UT, now they reject a ton of top applicants. True everywhere.

I’m a Vandy alum, Marcus, but thanks for letting me know about the school. The truth is this, every SEC school — and many Southern schools overall — are surging in popularity. All of them are seeing applications soar and admit rates plummet from Vandy to Ole Miss.


Marcus Matthews (@GaTechAlum_IE92)

Vanderbilt is a small elite private school that’s closer to Duke, Cornell, Emory, and Princeton in image and prestige

Trying to connect it to big public State colleges like Tennessee, Clemson, Ala

LeBron says he doesn’t want to go to Memphis to play the Grizzlies, that team should move to Nashville.

Video

Lee Zeldin would be a great AG choice. But if Trump went outside the cabinet, here are three names I’d seriously consider who would all be excellent: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis, and two senators who would likely be confirmed with ease: Texas’s Ted Cruz and Utah’s Mike Lee.
President Trump has fired AG Pam Bondi.

This feels like it will end up at the Supreme Court. Central question, do states or the federal government control sports gambling/prediction markets?


Ben Horney (@BenHorney)

NEWS: The CFTC has sued the state of Illinois, its gaming board, and state officials over attempts to prohibit prediction markets. 

This is a major escalation, it’s the first suit brought by the gov’t against a state that has tried to rein in the industry. 

Story to come @FOS



— https://nitter.net/BenHorney/status/20

Vanderbilt University announces they admitted just 1382 students out of 48,720 regular decision applicants. That’s an acceptance rate of 2.8%. SEC and southern ACC schools, led by Vanderbilt, are white hot when it comes to nationwide desirability.

No European or Asian country gives by soil citizenship. Nor does any country in your beloved Middle East.


Mehdi Hasan (@mehdirhasan)

Because.... we're not China?



— https://nitter.net/mehdirhasan/status/2039561070767944173#m
Some of you should read more and Tweet less. Laws aren’t complicated to look up.

There are currently background checks and red flag laws for gun purchases. Some agree with them, some disagree. But they are legal. The first amendment is not absolute, nor is the fourth amendment. Congress — and the courts — regularly analyze legislation relating to amendments.


Brett Kollmann (@BrettKollmann)

So this argument works for citizenship debates but not for background checks and red flag laws?



— https://nitter.net/BrettKollmann/status/2039424935828115720#m
